The narrator is a wanted criminal suspect hiding out. Police located him at his house and placed a food delivery order there as a ruse — the fake delivery would both confirm he was at that address and serve as the trigger. Someone announces the food delivery; since the narrator ordered nothing, he is confused and about to refuse it. His sister and girlfriend, who have some awareness of the danger/setup (but are not simply coerced, nor purely bystanders fearing for him), fearfully shake their heads. The announcement/time confirms the target's location to the waiting police, and several burly men — police officers — rush in and pin down the narrator to arrest him for the crime he committed.
